verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUMUSSEEKO-engule
Omwana gw'endiga;
Muwulire-amatendo ge
Agatenkanika.
Yimba mwoyo gwange,
N'amaanyi go gonna,
Oyatule Kabaka wo
Eyakufiirira.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mumusseeko-engule
Omwana w'omuntu,
Yawangula-abalabe be
Abaamujeemera.
Banabbi ab'edda
Bye baamulangako,
Byonna yabituukiriza
Bwe yabeera mu nsi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mumusseeko-engule
Nnannyini kwagala,
Enkovu z'ebiwundu bye
Zonna zirabika.
Kino kya kitalo
Ekitenkanika,
-Emikono gye-emifumite
Gye gituwa-obulamu-

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mumusseeko-engule
Mukama w'eggulu,
Eyatuwanguza fenna
Abamweyabiza
Mununuzi waffe,
Kkiriza-ettendo lyo
-Emirembe-agitalabika
Lye giri kussaako
